label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
**Kilbarrack Van Co: 4 stars**

I used these lads for a move from Phibsborough to Drumcondra on Saturday 17 October. It was a two-bed flat, though mostly just my own stuff, and the new place was a fourth floor walkup with no lift. I'm writing this to give a fair picture for anyone deciding, because it's mostly good with a couple of things worth knowing.

The price is the main reason to book them. I was quoted €340 for up to four hours with two lads and the van. Every other quote I got was €450 or more. Booking was easy through their website, with a €50 deposit by Revolut. The job came in at about three and a half hours, and Dessie knocked €40 off the final price because of the lateness, which I didn't ask for. I thought that was decent of him.

The lateness is the bit to be aware of. They were due at 9 and arrived at half ten. To be fair, I got a text at 8:40 saying the previous job had overrun, so I wasn't left wondering. But I was still sitting on a pile of boxes with a cold coffee for an hour and a half. It wasn't a disaster for me. If you're on a tight handover with a landlord, though, it could be a real problem, so I'd build in a buffer or ask for a firm arrival time when you book.

Once they got going, the lads were great. The couch wouldn't go around the turn on the third floor and I was already bracing for a nightmare. The younger lad took the legs off with an allen key he had in his pocket and it went straight up. They put my bed back together without me asking, and they took away a flat pack shelf I didn't want to bring with me. Nobody was rushing me or moaning about the stairs, and that was four floors of them.

The one real negative is that my brass floor lamp got chipped at the base. They wrapped everything else in blankets but not the lamp, so it took a knock. It was my nanny's lamp, so I was a bit gutted. It's the kind of thing that's easy to avoid, so lads, wrap the lamps! If you've got anything fragile or sentimental, I'd point it out to them at the start and maybe wrap it yourself. I'm not sure they'd have been able to wrap it properly, but I'd rather have been asked.

I'm giving four stars rather than five because of the lateness and the lamp. They're not dealbreakers, but I wouldn't be honest if I left them out. I would use them again, though. For the price, and for the effort the lads put in on a tough job, they were the best value I found.

If you're moving and you're flexible on timing, they're well worth a call. If your timing is tight, get a firm arrival time in writing and keep anything precious close to hand.

---

I left the younger lad unnamed since you weren't sure it was Kev. If you can confirm, adding the name would be a nice touch. Also, the "wrap the lamps" line is the one most likely to get a laugh in the bar, so keep it or cut it depending on how much slagging you want.
